patch.summary: Carepatron implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Carepatron by mapping current hr workflows to Carepatron objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (priority systems) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on systems of record

blocks.heading: Carepatron day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Carepatron setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for employee training paths, HRIS integrations before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Solo and small healthcare/wellness practices before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate priority integrations before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS
Do not expand seats until employee training paths is green

items.body: Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Carepatron plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: core hris, employee training paths, HRIS integrations · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate hr fit before a deep Carepatron rollout
blocks.body: If Carepatron fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Carepatron object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on employee training paths
